pages.title: Less busywork. More time to advise.
pages.description: TaxFlow AI helps solo Chartered Accountants collect client documents, prepare information for review, and keep the professional in control.
pages.summary: The TaxFlow AI homepage explains the product’s India-first direction for solo Chartered Accountants. It introduces document collection, AI-assisted preparation, human review, and current product status.
pages.imageAlt: Screenshot of the TaxFlow AI homepage, showing its tax-practice workflow overview.

pages.title: TaxFlow AI product details
pages.description: See how TaxFlow AI is designed to organize tax documents, assist data preparation, and keep review decisions with the accountant.
pages.summary: The product page describes TaxFlow AI’s intended practice workflow, current internal testing, human review guardrails, and planned capabilities. It distinguishes the working demo from features that are not yet available.
pages.imageAlt: Screenshot of the TaxFlow AI product page, with its workflow details and current product status.

pages.title: TaxFlow AI workflow comparison
pages.description: Compare a common document-heavy accounting workflow with the connected workflow TaxFlow AI is being designed to support.
pages.summary: This page compares common manual document-work steps with TaxFlow AI’s intended workflow. The comparison is qualitative, not a measured time-saving or accuracy claim.
pages.imageAlt: Screenshot of the TaxFlow AI workflow comparison page, showing its side-by-side process explanation.

pages.title: TaxFlow AI desktop app
pages.description: Learn about the TaxFlow AI desktop workspace for independent Chartered Accountants. The app is in development and not yet available to install.
pages.summary: The get-app page explains the planned desktop workspace and shows a clearly labeled concept illustration. The application is still in development; no download is available yet.
pages.imageAlt: Screenshot of the TaxFlow AI desktop-app information page, including its concept workspace.

pages.title: Join the TaxFlow AI waitlist
pages.description: Join the TaxFlow AI early-access waitlist for solo Chartered Accountants and receive occasional product updates.
pages.summary: The waitlist page lets solo Chartered Accountants request early-access updates. Joining is free, does not guarantee access, and does not require client documents or payment details.
pages.imageAlt: Screenshot of the TaxFlow AI waitlist page, showing its early-access information and signup form.

pages.title: TaxFlow AI privacy notice
pages.description: Read how the TaxFlow AI website, waitlist, and invited-client portal collect and handle information.
pages.summary: The privacy notice describes information submitted to the waitlist, the client portal’s document flow, the service providers involved, and the choices available to visitors and invited clients.
pages.imageAlt: Screenshot of the TaxFlow AI privacy notice page.

pages.title: TaxFlow AI website terms
pages.description: Review the terms for using the TaxFlow AI website, early-access waitlist, and invited-client portal.
pages.summary: The terms explain acceptable website and portal use, the limits of joining the waitlist, and that website content is informational rather than professional advice.
pages.imageAlt: Screenshot of the TaxFlow AI website terms page.

pages.title: TaxFlow AI invited-client portal
pages.description: Invited clients can use the TaxFlow AI portal to securely share supported documents with their accounting practice.
pages.summary: The client portal is a private, invitation-only destination for clients sharing supported documents with their accounting practice. It is not a public signup or marketing page.
pages.imageAlt: Screenshot of the TaxFlow AI client portal for invited practice clients.

pages.title: TaxFlow AI website directory
pages.description: Browse the TaxFlow AI website by page, with clear descriptions of the product, workflows, waitlist, client portal, and policies.
pages.summary: The website directory links to every TaxFlow AI page and briefly explains what visitors can find there, including product information, early access, legal notices, and the invitation-only client portal.
pages.imageAlt: Screenshot of the TaxFlow AI website directory, listing its pages and descriptions.
